findings.claim: SDK streaming_execute returns NDJSON bytes and CLI successfully writes returned bytes.
findings.evidence: Frozen SDK1.101 source query SHA5242d695ca2cc7ae2ea0afccc814bece3f3d77bea98a5c11beb53ec2e4dedcde matches formal085 oracle. Method returns AsyncSseContextManager with text/event-stream. Actual CLI _invoke returns that manager; .decode raises AttributeError before HTTP. Entering manager with MockTransport decodes typed data/error events.
findings.supported_patch: Implement CLI consumption of typed SSE, retaining intended NDJSON stdout. Explain server SSE and CLI conversion accurately. Independently retest actual transport, error events, timeout and cleanup after implementation.

findings.claim: Timeout can interrupt stream after partial stdout.
findings.evidence: Current CLI awaits result before a single stdout write, and actual SDK manager fails decode. No NDJSON is emitted before failure.
findings.supported_patch: Match timeout/partial-output guidance to final streaming implementation; do not claim partial stdout without evidence.

findings.evidence: Both execute and streaming_execute SDK docs define transaction ID as transaction to read from, with experimental workflow support.
findings.supported_patch: Replace both descriptions with reads from specified transaction; transaction support is experimental and not all workflows may be supported.

findings.claim: ontology selects Ontology used to resolve query object inputs.
findings.evidence: SDK ontology parameter selects ontology-scoped function; absence selects global function. execute endpoint handles global functions.
findings.supported_patch: Describe function execution scope explicitly; supplied ontology RID/API name executes ontology-scoped query, omission executes global query. Clarify execute scope.

findings.claim: Version-id example uses integer 1; prose points to version listing.
findings.evidence: ValueTypeVersionId is constrained core.UUID; real SDK rejects 1 before HTTP. ValueType and VersionId metadata carry versionId; this CLI has no listing operation.
findings.supported_patch: Use a UUID version ID, distinguish versionId from numeric version, and obtain it from value-type get metadata.

findings.evidence: This sentence exists in older supplied unpublished0.0.0 snapshot. Frozen1.101 execute docstring describes global execution and directs incremental streaming callers to streamingExecute, without backward-compatibility-only status.
